label: Low oxygen · caution

alert.text: Low oxygen margin: turn back before the reserve is needed.

notes: suit.marginSec is computed by the suit model as oxygen time left minus walkback minus the 30 min reserve (suit.reserve.time in hazards.json). The 900 s caution threshold is 15 min, the caution limit in docs/STATE_AND_ENGINE.md. The 5 min duration keeps a manual demo alert visible; it does not replace the warning event.
